CREATE TRIGGER conversation_selection_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON workspace.conversation_memory_selections FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_immutable_update()
CREATE TRIGGER conversation_message_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON workspace.conversation_messages FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_immutable_update()
CREATE TRIGGER conversation_terminal_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON workspace.conversation_turns FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((old.status <> 'PENDING'::text)) EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_immutable_update()
CREATE TRIGGER knowledge_revision_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON workspace.knowledge_revisions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_immutable_update()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION workspace.reject_immutable_update()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable Workspace record'; END;
$function$
